deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 pm Pacific (Biochemistry, Molecular and Structural Biology track: December 5).

also.quote: The deadline for Chemistry applications is December 1, 11:59pm Pacific Standard Time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE (General or Chemistry Subject) is required.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, though the department says scores are encouraged.

also.quote: While not required, GRE scores are encouraged for those applying to the Fall 2026 admission cycle.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 87 overall with at least 24 in Speaking.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT: Your overall TOEFL score must be an 87 or higher. The department requires a minimum speaking score of 24.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 7.0 in Speaking.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: Your overall IELTS band score must be 7.0 or higher. The department requires a minimum speaking score of 7.0.

supervisor.value: Not stated as a requirement; the statement of purpose may name potential faculty mentors.

funding.value: The department funds tuition, fees, health insurance and a living stipend for all graduate students through TA or researcher appointments; at least three quarters of TA work are required.
funding.quote: The Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry fully supports all graduate students with appointments as teaching assistants or graduate student researchers. The Department funds tuition, student fees, health insurance, and an annual stipend for living expenses for students enrolled in the program.

entry_route.value: Not stated explicitly; the department has no traditional master's program and admits to the M.S. only in exceptional cases.

notes: Biochemistry, Molecular and Structural Biology is a separate Ph.D. in the same department; applicants may apply to only one.
